explainerWhatBody: Sync downloads your game content - scenarios, patterns, images and videos - from Tag Hunter Studio onto this device, so everything is ready to play, even without internet. At launch the app checks for new content and asks before downloading it; after that it keeps itself up to date, and <2>Sync now</2> forces an immediate check for the latest content.
explainerNotSameBody: Sync keeps the <1>content you play with</1> up to date. The <4>Updates</4> tab is separate - it installs a new version of the <7>app itself</7>. Changing your scenarios never needs an app update, and updating the app doesn't re-download your content.
